tasks.subject: Task 0: Console + CLI prep (user, non-code)
tasks.description:
**Files:** see plan Layout
**Goal:** Firebase project; Android app `io.github.codenam.tenpai` with the debug SHA-1 (`keytool -list -v -keystore ~/.android/debug.keystore -alias androiddebugkey -storepass android`); Authentication → Email/Password + Google enabled; Firestore production mode, region europe-west/eur3; App Check → Play Integrity (debug token registered in Task 1). Install `npm i -g firebase-tools`, `dart pub global activate flutterfire_cli`; `firebase login`; `firebase init firestore` at repo root (firebase.json, .firebaserc, firestore.rules, firestore.indexes.json); `flutterfire configure --platforms=android`.
**Acceptance Criteria:** android/app/google-services.json and lib/firebase_options.dart exist; git status does not list them (git-ignored); firebase.json + .firebaserc committed
**Verify:** ls android/app/google-services.json lib/firebase_options.dart && git status --short
```json:metadata
{"verifyCommand": "ls android/app/google-services.json lib/firebase_options.dart && git status --short", "acceptanceCriteria": ["android/app/google-services.json and lib/firebase_options.dart exist", "git status does not list them (git-ignored)", "firebase.json + .firebaserc committed"], "modelTier": "mechanical", "owner": "user"}
```
**Done:** 2026-09-23. `flutterfire configure` failed (project list API hides tenpai-3f494 for the CLI account although `apps:list --project` works); `firebase_options.dart` written by hand from google-services.json via /implement.

tasks.subject: Task 1: Dependencies + Firebase bootstrap
tasks.description:
**Files:** see plan Layout
**Goal:** `flutter pub add firebase_core firebase_auth cloud_firestore firebase_app_check` (approved: CLAUDE.md §1.10). Read pub-cache: `firebase_auth-6.7.0/lib/src/firebase_auth.dart` for `signInWithProvider`, `firebase_app_check` for `AndroidProvider`. `main.dart`: `WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()`, `await Firebase.initializeApp(options: DefaultFirebaseOptions.currentPlatform)`, `await FirebaseAppCheck.instance.activate(androidProvider: kDebugMode ? AndroidProvider.debug : AndroidProvider.playIntegrity)`. Confirm minSdk ≥ 23.
**Acceptance Criteria:** app boots on the emulator; logcat prints the App Check debug token; token registered in the console; signInWithProvider on Android confirmed in source (else stop: google_sign_in needs approval)
**Verify:** flutter analyze && dart run tool/check_conventions.dart && flutter run
```json:metadata
{"verifyCommand": "flutter analyze && dart run tool/check_conventions.dart && flutter run", "acceptanceCriteria": ["app boots on the emulator", "logcat prints the App Check debug token; token registered in the console", "signInWithProvider on Android confirmed in source (else stop: google_sign_in needs approval)"], "modelTier": "mechanical", "owner": "user"}
```
**Done:** 2026-09-23. `signInWithProvider` confirmed in firebase_auth 6.7.0; `providerAndroid: AndroidDebugProvider/AndroidPlayIntegrityProvider` (the `androidProvider` param is deprecated). Native auto-init warning in logcat is expected without the google-services Gradle plugin.
